SELECT A.DISPOSAL_NO , A.DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE , A.IN_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.DISPOSAL_REASON , A.DISPOSAL_CODE , A.DISPOSAL_NAME , A.CUSTOMER_CODE , A.CUSTOMER_NAME , dbo.Cryptography(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, A.CUSTOMER_TEL, 1) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , A.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , A.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , A.AMOUNT_USD , A.DISPOSAL_LOC , A.DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE , A.DISPOSAL_METHOD , A.DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE , A.PKG_TYPE , A.DISPOSAL_CT , A.DISPOSAL_WT , A.OUT_YN , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , 'DISPOSAL' AS SD_TYPE , B.CARRYIN_DATE, B.CARRYIN_TIME , B.CD_TYPE , IIF(B.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(ISNULL(B.CD_TYPE, '') != 'Y', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT , B.ECM_TYPE, B.CD_USE_TYPE , B.IMPORT_EXPORT_CLASS, B.VESSEL_FLIGHT, B.VOYAGE, B.AR_DATE, B.AR_TIME, B.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , B.LOCATION_PLACE,B.REMARKS_1, B.REMARKS_2, B.REMARKS_3, B.REFERENCE_NO , B.OD_JOB_NO , ISNULL(D.HOLD_YN,'N') AS HOLD_YN , D.HOLD_CODE , D.HOLD_REASON , D.HOLD_RELEASE_YN , D.HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , D.HOLD_RELEASE_DATE , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE FUNC_JOB_NO = B.OD_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE FROM TB_BMS_DISPOSAL A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_YN , MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , MAX(HOLD_CODE) AS HOLD_CODE , MAX(HOLD_REASON) AS HOLD_REASON , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_DATE) AS HOLD_RELEASE_DATE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) D ON B.OD_JOB_NO = D.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND 1 = 0

SELECT A.IN_NO , A.CUSTOMS_REPORT_NO , A.LAST_POD_DATE , A.LAST_POD_STATUS , A.LAST_POD_5TL_STATUS , A.LAST_POD_RAQ_DATE , A.LAST_POD_R48_DATE , A.IN_CLASS , A.IN_APPROVAL_NO , A.TRANS_PERIOD_DATE , A.OD_JOB_NO , A.IN_PLAN_NO , A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.BL_NO , A.MBL_NO , A.CUSTOMS_CODE , A.CUSTOMS_DPT_CODE , A.INSPECT_YN , A.NOTICE_INSPECT_YN , A.LOCATION_PLACE , A.IMPORT_EXPORT_CLASS , A.VESSEL_FLIGHT , A.VOYAGE , A.AR_DATE , A.AR_TIME , A.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC , A.SHIPPER_CODE , A.SHIPPER_NAME , A.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_1 , A.SHIPPER_ADDRESS_2 , A.CONSIGNEE_CODE , A.CONSIGNEE_NAME , A.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_1 , A.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_BUSINESS_ID , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.CONSIGNEE_TEL, 1) AS CONSIGNEE_TEL , A.NOTIFY_CODE , A.NOTIFY_NAME , A.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_1 , A.NOTIFY_ADDRESS_2 , dbo.Cryptography(A.OD_JOB_NO, A.NOTIFY_TEL, 1) AS NOTIFY_TEL , A.SPECIAL_CODE_1 , A.SPECIAL_CODE_2 , A.SPECIAL_CODE_3 , A.CARRIER_CODE , A.CNTR_NO , A.ORIG_COUNTRY , A.SE_INSPECTION_CODE , A.SIMPLE_AUTH_NAME , A.INSPECTION_TYPE , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_A , A.INSPECTION_TYPE_B , A.XRAY_INSPECTION_CODE , A.XRAY_LINE_NO , A.XRAY_CHECK , A.PALN5EM_INSPECTION_CODE , A.CD_TYPE , IIF(A.CD_TYPE = 'Y', 1, 0) AS SIMPLE_CNT , IIF(ISNULL(A.CD_TYPE, '') != 'Y', 1, 0) AS GENERAL_CNT , A.ECM_TYPE , A.CD_USE_TYPE , A.BIG_SIZE_YN , A.AMOUNT_USD , A.XRAY_SCAN_CT , A.XRAY_IMAGE_CT , A.CARRYIN_DATE , A.CARRYIN_TIME , A.OUT_NOTICE_DATE , A.PERIOD_OVER_DATE , A.CUSTOMER_CODE , A.CUSTOMER_NAME , A.FWD_CODE , A.FWD_NAME , A.PKG_TYPE , A.EX_CT , A.EX_WT , A.EX_CBM , A.CT , A.WT , A.CBM , A.ACCIDENT_CLASS , A.ACCIDENT_CT , A.ACCIDENT_WT , A.ACCIDENT_CBM , A.STOCK_CT , A.STOCK_WT , A.STOCK_CBM , A.CARRYOUT_DATE , A.CARRYOUT_TIME , A.REMARKS_1 , A.REMARKS_2 , A.REMARKS_3 , A.REFERENCE_NO , A.MGN_ISSUE_YN , A.REGISTER_USER_ID , A.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , A.UPDATE_USER_ID , A.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , A.CRIME_SELECTION_YN , A.ASSIGN_YN , ISNULL(D.HOLD_YN,'N') AS HOLD_YN , D.HOLD_CODE , D.HOLD_REASON , D.HOLD_RELEASE_YN , D.HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , D.HOLD_RELEASE_DATE , CASE WHEN (SELECT TOP 1 REFERENCE_NO_ID FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE WHERE FUNC_JOB_NO = A.OD_JOB_NO) IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END AS FILE_SHARE , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE USER_ID = A.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , 'STOCK' AS SD_TYPE FROM TB_BMS_IN A WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN (SELECT 'Y' AS HOLD_YN , MAX(OD_JOB_NO) AS OD_JOB_NO , MAX(HOLD_CODE) AS HOLD_CODE , MAX(HOLD_REASON) AS HOLD_REASON , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_YN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_YN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN) AS HOLD_RELEASE_ATTN , MAX(HOLD_RELEASE_DATE) AS HOLD_RELEASE_DATE FROM TB_ECM_OD_HOLD GROUP BY OD_JOB_NO) D ON A.OD_JOB_NO = D.OD_JOB_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND 1 = 0
AND A.DISPOSAL_YN ='N' AND A.STOCK_WT > 0

mapper.insert: /* BmsDisposalMapper.insertDisposalBatchGen */ INSERT INTO TB_BMS_DISPOSAL ( DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE , IN_NO , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , BL_NO , MBL_NO , DISPOSAL_REASON , DISPOSAL_CODE , DISPOSAL_NAME , CUSTOMER_CODE , CUSTOMER_NAME , CUSTOMER_TEL , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , AMOUNT_USD , DISPOSAL_LOC , DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE , DISPOSAL_METHOD , DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE , PKG_TYPE , DISPOSAL_CT , DISPOSAL_WT , OUT_YN , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME ) SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),${dateFormat}) AS DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE , IN_NO , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , BL_NO , MBL_NO , #{disposalReason} AS DISPOSAL_REASON , #{disposalCode} AS DISPOSAL_CODE , #{disposalName} AS DISPOSAL_NAME , tbi.CUSTOMER_CODE , tbi.CUSTOMER_NAME , dbo.Cryptography(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, ISNULL(tsc.TEL,''), 0) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , ISNULL(tsc.ADDRESS,'') AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , ISNULL(tsc.ADDRESS_A,'') AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , AMOUNT_USD , #{disposalLoc} AS DISPOSAL_LOC , #{disposalExpDate} AS DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE , #{disposalMethod} AS DISPOSAL_METHOD , '' AS DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE , PKG_TYPE , CT AS DISPOSAL_CT , WT AS DISPOSAL_WT , 'N' OUT_YN , #{registerUserId} REGISTER_USER_ID , GETDATE() REGISTER_DATE_TIME , #{updateUserId} UPDATE_USER_ID , GETDATE() UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_BMS_IN tbi WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER tsc ON tbi.CUSTOMER_CODE = tsc.CUSTOMER_CODE where tbi.IN_NO = #{inNo}

/* BmsDisposalMapper.insertDisposalBatchGenWithExcelData */ INSERT INTO TB_BMS_DISPOSAL ( DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE , IN_NO , CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , BL_NO , MBL_NO , DISPOSAL_REASON , DISPOSAL_CODE , DISPOSAL_NAME , CUSTOMER_CODE , CUSTOMER_NAME , CUSTOMER_TEL , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , AMOUNT_USD , DISPOSAL_LOC , DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE , DISPOSAL_METHOD , DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE , PKG_TYPE , DISPOSAL_CT , DISPOSAL_WT , OUT_YN , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME ) SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),${dateFormat}) AS DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE , IN_NO , ISNULL(NULLIF(#{cargoReferenceNo}, ''), CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) , ISNULL(NULLIF(#{blNo}, ''), BL_NO) , MBL_NO , #{disposalReason} AS DISPOSAL_REASON , #{disposalCode} AS DISPOSAL_CODE , #{disposalName} AS DISPOSAL_NAME , tbi.CUSTOMER_CODE , ISNULL(NULLIF(tbi.CUSTOMER_NAME, ''), #{customerName}) , dbo.Cryptography(CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, ISNULL(tsc.TEL,''), 0) AS CUSTOMER_TEL , ISNULL(tsc.ADDRESS,'') AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_1 , ISNULL(tsc.ADDRESS_A,'') AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS_2 , AMOUNT_USD , #{disposalLoc} AS DISPOSAL_LOC , #{disposalExpDate} AS DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE , #{disposalMethod} AS DISPOSAL_METHOD , '' AS DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE , ISNULL(NULLIF(#{pkgType}, ''), PKG_TYPE) , CASE WHEN ISNULL(#{disposalCt}, 0) = 0 THEN CT ELSE #{disposalCt} END AS DISPOSAL_CT , CASE WHEN ISNULL(#{disposalWt}, 0) = 0 THEN WT ELSE #{disposalWt} END AS DISPOSAL_WT , 'N' OUT_YN , #{registerUserId} REGISTER_USER_ID , GETDATE() REGISTER_DATE_TIME , #{updateUserId} UPDATE_USER_ID , GETDATE() UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_BMS_IN tbi WITH (NOLOCK) LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER tsc ON tbi.CUSTOMER_CODE = tsc.CUSTOMER_CODE where tbi.IN_NO = #{inNo};
INSERT INTO TB_ECM_POD_05 ( ENT_CODE , OD_JOB_NO , POD_STATUS , POD_NAME , POD_DATE , POD_TIME , REMARKS , REGISTER_USER_ID , REGISTER_DATE_TIME , UPDATE_USER_ID , UPDATE_DATE_TIME ) VALUES ( #{entCode} , #{odJobNo} , 'ECM288' , #{podName} , GETDATE() , SUBSTRING(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), GETDATE(), 108), 1, 8) , #{podRemarks} , #{registerUserId} , GETDATE() , #{registerUserId} , GETDATE() );
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = #{cargoReferenceNo} AND OUT_CLASS ='83' AND OUT_APPROVAL_NO =''
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BMS_IN SET TB_BMS_IN.STOCK_CT = ( TB_BMS_IN.CT - ISNULL(T.OUT_CT,0)), TB_BMS_IN.STOCK_WT = ( TB_BMS_IN.WT - ISNULL(T.OUT_WT,0)) , TB_BMS_IN.STOCK_CBM = ( TB_BMS_IN.CBM - ISNULL(T.OUT_CBM,0)), TB_BMS_IN.CARRYOUT_DATE = T.CARRYOUT_DATE, TB_BMS_IN.CARRYOUT_TIME = T.CARRYOUT_TIME FROM TB_BMS_IN INNER JOIN (SELECT IN_NO , OUT_CT , OUT_WT , OUT_CBM , LEFT(CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME,10) CARRYOUT_DATE , RIGHT( CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME,8) CARRYOUT_TIME FROM ( SELECT #{inNo} AS IN_NO , SUM(OUT_CT) AS OUT_CT , SUM(OUT_WT) AS OUT_WT , SUM(OUT_CBM) AS OUT_CBM , MAX(CONCAT(CARRYOUT_DATE,'', CARRYOUT_TIME)) AS CARRYOUT_DATE_TIME FROM TB_BMS_OUT WITH (NOLOCK) where IN_NO = #{inNo} group by IN_NO )T1 ) T ON TB_BMS_IN.IN_NO = T.IN_NO WHERE TB_BMS_IN.IN_NO = #{inNo}
mapper.select: SELECT A.DISPOSAL_NO , A.IN_NO , (CASE WHEN LEN(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO) > 15 THEN ( SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 16, 4) ) ELSE SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 1, 11) + '-' + SUBSTRING(A.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO, 12, 4) END) AS CARGO_REFERENCE_NO , A.BL_NO -- 화주 정보 , A.CUSTOMER_NAME -- 신청인 정보 ( 담당자 ( 대표자 ) ) 테이블 위치 [신청인,신청업체명, 신청인연락처, 신청인 주소, 신청일자] , usr.BUSINESS_PRESIDENT , usr.FROM_BUSINESS_NAME , usr.TEL , CONCAT (usr.ADDRESS , usr.ADDRESS_A ) FROM_ADDRESS , usr.CUSTOMER_NAME_BY_LOGIN , usr.CUSTOMER_TEL , usr.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS , A.DISPOSAL_ISSUE_DATE -- 폐기 업체 정보 ( 폐기 업체명, 사업자 번호, 폐기 업체 주) , A.DISPOSAL_NAME , tsc.BUSINESS_SUB_REG_NO , CONCAT (tsc.ADDRESS , tsc.ADDRESS_A, tsc.ADDRESS_B ) AS DISPOSAL_ADDR , CONCAT (usr.BMS_WH_CODE ,' ', usr.CUSTOMER_NAME_BY_LOGIN) BMS_WH_CODE -- 폐기 정보 (보세구역 폐기장소 폐기예정일자 폐기방법 폐기사유 폐기신청수량 폐기신청중량 폐기신청가격(CIF) 반출일자 폐기완료일자) , A.DISPOSAL_LOC , A.DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE -- 폐기예정일자, 반출일자 동일 , A.DISPOSAL_METHOD , A.DISPOSAL_REASON , A.DISPOSAL_CT , A.DISPOSAL_WT , 'uni-pass 등록 승인' AS DISPOSAL_AMOUNT , A.DISPOSAL_EXP_DATE DISP_OUT_DATE -- 반출일자 ( 폐기에서 반출 넘기는 날자?) , A.DISPOSAL_FINISH_DATE -- 폐기 물품 내역 ( 품명 규격 수량 중량 가격(USD)) , B.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC -- 품명, 규격 동 , B.COMMODITY_ITEM_LOC ITEM_SPEC , B.STOCK_CT , B.STOCK_WT , 'uni-pass 등록 승인' AMOUNT_USD FROM TB_BMS_DISPOSAL A LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN B WITH (NOLOCK) ON A.IN_NO = B.IN_NO LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_CUSTOMER tsc ON A.DISPOSAL_CODE = tsc.CUSTOMER_CODE LEFT JOIN ( SELECT su.USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , su.USER_NAME /* 사용자명 */ , su.ENT_CODE AS FROM_ENT_CODE /* 도입사 코드 */ , su.USER_TEL AS FROM_USER_TEL /* 사용자 전화번호 */ , su.USER_TEL_EXTENSION AS FROM_USER_TEL_EX /* 사용자 내선번호 */ , su.USER_FAX AS FROM_USER_FAX /* 사용자 팩스번호 */ , su.USER_EMAIL AS FROM_USER_EMAIL /* 사용자 이메일 */ , busi.ENT_BUSINESS_CODE AS FROM_BUSINESS_CODE /* 사업장 코드 (로그인 오피스의 거래처 코드) */ , busi.ENT_BUSINESS_NAME AS FROM_BUSINESS_NAME /* 사업장명 (로그인 오피스의 거래처명) */ , busi.ENT_BUSINESS_NAME_ENG AS OFFICE_NAME_ENG /* 사업장명 영문 (로그인 오피스의 거래처명 영문) */ , busi.BMS_WH_CODE /* 사업장 보세구역번호*/ , busi.TEL /* 사업장 전화번호 */ , busi.FAX /* 사업장 FAX번호 */ , busi.EMAIL /* 사업장 이메일 */ , busi.ZIPCODE /* 우편번호 */ , busi.ADDRESS /* 주소 */ , busi.ADDRESS_A /* 사업장주소A */ , busi.ADDRESS_ENG /* 사업장주소 영문 */ , busi.ADDRESS_A_ENG /* 사업장주소A 영문 */ , busi.ADDRESS_B_ENG /* 사업장주소B 영문 */ , busi.HOME_PAGE_URL AS FROM_BUSINESS_HOMPAGE_URL /* 사업장 홈페이지 */ , ( SELECT BUSINESS_PRESIDENT FROM VTB_SMS_BUSINESS_REG_INFO reg WHERE cus.REGISTRATION_CODE = reg.REGISTRATION_CODE ) AS BUSINESS_PRESIDENT /* 사업장 대표자성명 */ , cus.CUSTOMER_NAME AS CUSTOMER_NAME_BY_LOGIN /* 로그인한 지점의 거래처의정보의 거래처명 */ , cus.TEL AS CUSTOMER_TEL /* 로그인한 지점의 거래처의정보의 전화 */ , CONCAT_WS (' ', cus.ADDRESS , cus.ADDRESS_A , cus.ADDRESS_B ) AS CUSTOMER_ADDRESS /* 로그인한 지점의 거래처의정보의 주소 */ FROM TB_SMS_USER su LEFT JOIN TB_SMS_ENT_BUSINESS busi ON su.ENT_CODE = busi.ENT_CODE AND /* BmsDisposalMapper.selectDiscardScan : 폐기자료 조회 */ SELECT PKG.PACKING_NO ,D.BL_NO ,D.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ,D.DISPOSAL_REASON FROM TB_BMS_DISPOSAL D INNER JOIN( SELECT P.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO ,K.PACKING_NO FROM TB_BMS_IN_PLAN_PKG K LEFT JOIN TB_BMS_IN_PLAN P ON K.IN_PLAN_NO = P.IN_PLAN_NO WHERE (K.PACKING_NO = #{blNo} OR P.BL_NO = #{blNo}) AND K.DELETE_YN = 'N' ) PKG ON D.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO = PKG.CARGO_REFERENCE_NO
